title: Web Developer Intern Konstruct Digital - 3 Jobs Calgary, AB Salary not specified Salary: 20 per hour Web Development Intern (Paid) Want to learn from the brains behind one of Canadas fastest-growing B2B digital marketing agencies? Konstruct is looking for a Web Development Intern to work on real client projects, sharpen your coding skills, and get hands-on experience building modern, responsive websites. If youre looking to fast-track your career in web developmentthis is it! About Konstruct Calgary-based B2B digital marketing agency with clients across North America. Experts in search, paid, and content marketing. Healthy work-life balance and a team culture that values learning, curiosity, and fun (Thursday team lunches, foosball tournaments, and more!). We believe the company grows when you growyour learning is just as important as the client results we deliver. Follow us and geek out with our work: Instagram | Facebook | LinkedIn About the Role This winter, were offering a 16-week paid internship (starting January 2026) for a Web Development Intern. Youll get real hands-on experience developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting websites while working alongside experienced developers. Candidates must be located in Calgary and currently enrolled in post-secondary school. Responsibilities: Build, customize, and maintain client websites using WordPress and Gutenberg. Support front-end development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design. Assist with back-end tasks including PHP, MySQL, and plugin implementation. Conduct QA, debugging, and troubleshooting of web projects. Implement on-page SEO best practices and monitor site performance. Collaborate with designers, content specialists, and marketing strategists. Learn and use Git/version control for project workflows. Participate in internal culture eventsfoosball tournaments, office games, and team lunches. Candidate Profile Experience / Skills: Familiarity with WordPress development (themes, plugins, CMS) Knowledge of PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL/MariaDB, WordPress plugin development Exposure to Git or other version control systems Understanding of responsive design and website performance optimization Nice-to-have: Elementor, Divi or Shopify development experience Portfolio of websites/projects is a plus Qualities: Detail-oriented: you sweat the small stuff. Curious and eager to learn: you love experimenting with new tools and technologies. Problem-solver: you enjoy debugging and finding elegant solutions. Team player: you communicate well and collaborate easily. Passionate about web development and building high-quality websites. Internship Details & Perks Duration: 16-week paid internship starting January 2026 Compensation: $20.00 per hour Grant Funding: Venture for Canada Eligibility: Must be a full-time student in a post-secondary program and a Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or hold refugee status. International students are not eligible. Potential Full-Time Opportunity: High-performing interns may be offered full-time positions with competitive salaries. Perks include: Fun office culture and games (foosball, tournaments, office challenges) Fully stocked kitchen and free parking Work alongside a fast-growing team in a collaborative environment Portfolio Links: Please include links to websites or projects youve worked on. Required Skills: Javascript Sql Java Marketing Design View Details

title: Stagiaire en Developpement Web, Intern Software Web Developer Autodesk Montreal, QC Salary not specified Job Requisition ID # 25WD91266 English will follow Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un poste hybride pour l'hiver 2026 (periode de travail de janvier a avril 2026). Voici une opportunite incroyable pour travailler avec des professionnel.les qui construisent certaines des solutions d'animation 3D les plus avancees pour les effets speciaux d'Hollywood, les specialistes de la visualisation, les artistes de jeux et de films. Le groupe Entertainment and Media Solutions (EMS) est compose d'une gamme de logiciels utilises par des milliers de createur.ices et d'artistes de l'industrie des medias et du divertissement, tels que Maya, 3ds Max, Flame et ShotGrid. Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion d'acquerir une experience de developpement de premiere ligne dans un environnement stimulant. Tu travailleras avec une equipe de professionnel.les qui te guideront et partageront leur expertise dans ce domaine passionnant et important du developpement de logiciels. Tu pourras acquerir de nouvelles competences precieuses qui te permettront de faire avancer ta carriere. Responsabilites Etre un membre actif de notre equipe en developpant des fonctionnalites qui contribuent a offrir la meilleure experience en temps reel et les meilleurs flux de travail a nos clients grace aux dernieres technologies Participer a la conception iterative, aux tests et aux sprints de developpement afin d'affiner la solution produit. Qualifications minimales Etudes universitaires en Informatique, Genie Informatique ou Logiciel Connaissance de base de C++ Experience avec les outil de developpement Interet pour la programmation 3D, la modelisation ou l'animation Creativite, flexibilite et esprit d'equipe Bonnes habiletes de communication, capable d'exprimer ses idees a un groupe Qualifications souhaitees Connaissance de base de la gamme de produits d'Autodesk (3ds Max, Maya, Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor et FBX) Connaissance de la programmation 3D et/ou graphique Comprehension de la methodologie Agile Connaissance de Python -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Here is an incredible opportunity to work with professionals who build some of the most advanced 3D animation solutions for Hollywood's special-effects, visualization specialists, game and film artists. The Entertainment and Media Solutions (EMS) group is composed of a range of software used by thousands of creators and artists in the media and entertainment industry such as Maya, 3ds Max, Flame and ShotGrid.This is a great opportunity to get front-line development experience in a stimulating environment. You will work with a team of professionals who will provide guidance and share their expertise in this exciting and important area of software development. Learn some new invaluable skills to push your career to the clouds. Please note that this is ahybridposition for Winter 2026 (January -April 2026 work term) Responsibilities Be an active member of our team developing features helping provide the best real-time experience and workflows for our customers using the latest in technology Participate in iterative design, testing and development sprints to refine the product solution. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing your degree in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering, ideally with a focus on computer graphics and/or 3D programming Basic experience with C++ Experience with Debugging Exposure to Computer Graphics (either through internships or personal projects) You are creative, flexible and enjoy working with new technology You like to work with others; you communicate well and are ok with presenting your ideas in front of a group Preferred Qualifications Experience / Knowledge with 3D animation. Knowledge of the Autodesk family of software products. Familiarity with the Agile development process Experience / Knowledge of Python Learn More About Autodesk Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! Salary transparency Salary is one part of Autodesk's competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate's experience, educational level, and geographic location. Diversity & Belonging We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/diversity-and-belonging Required Skills: Python Communication Excel C++ Design View Details
